fields.name: Entrixy
fields.subtitle: Keys and access control
fields.promotionalText: Your access objects, guest keys and access settings together in one app.
fields.description:
Entrixy helps you manage gates, barriers, doors and other compatible access objects. Add your own object or a key received from its owner.

Use a compatible Bluetooth controller, a webhook or a telephone call. Issue guest keys, configure access for individual objects and pass access on within the limits set by the owner.

Set location, Wi-Fi and schedule conditions, action confirmation, a code and biometric authentication. View action history and connect a compatible object camera. Save an encrypted backup to transfer your access.

Control requires compatible equipment or a configured server and valid access. Automatic actions depend on permissions and iOS capabilities. Telephone calls are handed to the system Phone app.
